templates.name: Strong certificate mapping overview
templates.description: Latest KB5014754 KDC 39/41 observations per DC, event ID and certificate/account identity. Unlike serial-only grouping, this preserves different reporters and unparsed events (using their raw payload as fallback identity).

templates.name: Strong certificate mapping events
templates.description: KB5014754 KDC events 39 and 41, latest event per certificate serial number.

templates.name: Certificates and NTDS database size
templates.description: Latest SystemData_CL certificate/NTDS inventory. Certificate expiry is shown as UTC and days remaining. MDI/Arc use source certificate array order or flattened NotAfter order, which must be verified against the collector. Missing/unparseable expiry remains unknown.

templates.name: DC CPU idle capacity
templates.description: Average Processor/Processor Information % Idle Time for _Total over the selected range, rather than counting Perf rows or using an unrelated process counter. Requires collection of this performance counter.

templates.name: DC inventory and boot age
templates.description: Latest VMComputer OS/boot inventory. Supports suffixed and unsuffixed boot/OS columns. Missing boot telemetry stays unknown; boot-age colors are visualization examples, not an enforced restart policy.

templates.name: DCDiag success rates and failure counts
templates.description: Per DC and test: passed, failed, unknown observations and success percentage. KccEvent counts are included. Unrecognized/missing states are counted separately; no passed/failed observations yields an unknown percentage.

templates.name: DCDiag test status
templates.description: Latest test results per computer. Missing or unrecognized results remain unknown.

templates.name: Disk free space
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: Observed FSMO role changes
templates.description: Holder transitions observed within the selected range, independently per reporting DC/domain/role. The first observation is a baseline, empty holders are not changes. Requires ADConfig_CL.Computer; reports are not mixed across DCs.

templates.name: FSMO role holders
templates.description: Latest ADConfig_CL role snapshot per selected reporting computer and domain. Requires a Computer column identifying the reporting DC. Separate reporters remain visible to expose inconsistent observations.

templates.name: GPO and SYSVOL status history
templates.description: Workspace-wide history per Environment (domain) using the execution bin interval: maximum observed counts/sizes, with derived percentages. Selected systems route workspaces only. Gaps/missing metrics are not healthy zeros; colors are illustrative, not alert rules.

templates.name: GPO and SYSVOL statistics
templates.description: Workspace-wide SysvolStats_CL statistics, latest snapshot per Environment (domain). Selected systems choose the workspaces only; all domains in those workspaces may be included. Zero denominators and missing measurements remain unknown, not zero.

templates.name: DC heartbeat overview
templates.description: Selected-system baseline with latest heartbeat in the requested range. Older than 15 minutes is stale; missing telemetry remains unknown rather than healthy.

templates.name: Heartbeat and last reboot
templates.description: Latest heartbeat per selected computer; delayed after 20 minutes.

templates.name: Kerberos authentication events per DC
templates.description: Counts collected SecurityEvent 4768/4769 observations over the selected range, split by event ID. Requires security-event collection/auditing. Unlike the Grafana example, this does not count unrelated Perf rows.

templates.name: Kerberos authentications per second
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: Estimated Kerberos authentications
templates.description: Workbook estimate: sum of per-second samples multiplied by 60; assumes one sample per minute.

templates.name: Site-to-site LDAP latency gauge
templates.description: Latest reported latency per selected source DC and target DC, then average by source/target site direction. Gauge thresholds complement the existing honeycomb and trend; workspaces remain separate.

templates.name: LDAP latency by site
templates.description: Average of latest measurements per selected source computer and target DC; green 0 ms to red 2000 ms.

templates.name: LDAP latency over time
templates.description: LDAP authentication and simple query round-trip time by site direction.

templates.name: DC committed memory snapshot
templates.description: Latest Memory % Committed Bytes In Use per selected DC in the requested range, with configurable percentage colors. This is committed-memory utilization, not physical RAM usage.

templates.name: Memory utilization
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: System log Netlogon errors
templates.description: Events for the selected computers and time range.

templates.name: Netlogon connections without site mapping
templates.description: Event 5807 connection estimate, retaining the workbook's division by 255.

templates.name: Network bytes received
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: Network bytes sent
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: DC port connection observations
templates.description: VMConnection observations for destination ports 1-1024 during the selected range. Sum of LinksLive is an interval observation count, not a current connection count or proof that a service is currently reachable.

templates.name: Processor utilization
templates.description: Average performance counter per selected computer and instance.

templates.name: Replication failure details
templates.description: Latest reported replication state per selected reporter/destination/site/naming context, including last failure. This complements the zero-filled error trend. Invalid failure counts remain unknown instead of becoming zero.

templates.name: Replication errors over time
templates.description: Failure observations grouped by naming context, DC or site. Missing intervals are filled with zero; groups without any observations are omitted.

templates.name: Service and TLS event counts
templates.description: System Event counts for 7022, 7031, 7032, 36873 and 36874 with per-event last-seen timestamps. A zero means no matching events among observed System telemetry, not proof of complete collection.

templates.name: AD service status board
templates.description: Color-configured snapshot variant of AD service status. Latest observed state per DC/service in the selected range; absent services are not inferred to be running.

templates.name: Active Directory service status
templates.description: Latest reported state of the AD-related services listed in the workbook.

templates.name: Recent shutdown events
templates.description: Events for the selected computers and time range.

templates.name: DC disk free capacity
templates.description: Latest LogicalDisk % Free Space per DC and disk instance in the requested range. Disk instances remain separate and _Total is excluded; low free capacity is red, high free capacity green.

templates.name: System log errors
templates.description: Events for the selected computers and time range.

templates.name: System and Netlogon event counts
templates.description: System Event counts for 41, 6008, 5719, 5840 and 7001 with per-event last-seen timestamps. Rows exist only for DCs with System-event telemetry in range; missing systems must not be interpreted as healthy.

templates.name: System and certificate information
templates.description: NTDS database size and LDAPS, MDI and Arc certificate validity.

templates.name: CPU usage
templates.description: Average total processor utilization per selected computer.

templates.name: RAM usage
templates.description: Average committed memory utilization per selected computer.

templates.name: Kerberos authentications
templates.description: Counts Kerberos ticket-granting and service-ticket events 4768 and 4769.
